question: The RISC complex (RNA-induced silencing complex) of RNA silencing based on interference RNA:

options.opa: It degrades the guide strand of the small interfering RNA molecules (siRNA).
options.opb: It recognizes defective proteins and promotes their degradation.
options.opc: It has a structure similar to the ribosome, formed by numerous RNAs and proteins.
options.opd: It is formed, among others, by the Dicer protein, a type III ribonuclease.
options.ope: It is part of both the interference mechanism of the siRNA and the microRNA.
